messages:
ira: quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning. repeated pages from the async-queue worker during the quiet window. need owners, short fixes, and verification plan.

samir: i'll own alert tuning. current: instant error_count > 0 triggers. short-term change -> `avg_over_time(7m) > 0.02` and require 2 consecutive windows. i'll open a PR today with before/after fire counts.

lee: i'll take dedupe and routing. plan: dedupe_key = `queue_name:region` and route scheduled-window pages to the `low-priority` rota. will test dedupe in staging and post results. PR by Thu.

ops-lead: add acceptance criteria: 14-day rolling reduction >= 70% in pages for the quiet window and no increase in user-facing errors. owners must attach dashboard screenshots to close.

samir: small config snippet i'll include in the PR:
```yaml
alert: async-queue-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(7m) > 0.02
require: 2_consecutive_windows
suppression:
  when_tag: deploy=true
  window: 15m
dedupe_key: "queue_name:region"
```

oncall-bot: incident 2955554321 resolved by ira — duration 1h12m — postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2955554321 (auto)

lee: staging dedupe looked good 44d collapsed 4 duplicates into 1. will push WIP PR.

samir: PR up with synthetic test and pre/post firing counts. tagging for review.

ops-lead: timeline recap: samir PR today, lee PR Thu, checkpoint next Wed 10am to review dashboards. /remind @ops-team checkpoint next_wed 10:00

ira: thanks all 44f please update the postmortem action list with PR links and target dates so I can close items when acceptance criteria are met.
